articles.title: Telegram group at center of Jane Street insider-trading allegations in Terra collapse
articles.snippet: Newly unsealed filings detail a private chat dubbed ‘Bryce’s Secret’ that Terraform’s estate says gave Jane Street an informational edge before UST’s collapse.

articles.title: Despite Trump’s pledge, a CBDC is being explored behind closed doors, says former CTFC chair
articles.snippet: Publicly, the U.S. has fiercely opposed a Central Bank Digital Currency, but former CFTC Chairman Timothy Massad said it is inevitable and there will be one sooner or later.

articles.title: Bitcoin sees fresh US sell-off as markets await Nvidia 'biggest earnings event'
articles.snippet: Bitcoin struggles to overcome US selling pressure with markets on edge ahead of Nvidia's Q1 earnings report.

articles.title: Bernstein: Bitcoin miners becoming critical suppliers in AI infrastructure
articles.snippet: Bernstein says miners control 27 GW of planned power and $90 billion in AI deals, giving them a strategic edge as electricity becomes the main constraint on data center growth.
